# Vendored transcribe.cpp Swift bindings

The Swift wrapper in `TranscribeCpp/` is copied from
[transcribe.cpp v0.2.1](https://github.com/handy-computer/transcribe.cpp/tree/v0.2.1/bindings/swift/Sources/TranscribeCpp)
(MIT). The native Metal library is the matching
`TranscribeCpp.xcframework` fetched by SwiftPM from that release.
